memories.content: On 2026-10-01 Daniel moves to Toronto for good and Mara starts her first official shift on the permanent ICU contract; on the eve (2026-09-30) she could not sleep but for good reasons.

Mara reflected (2026-09-30) that Toronto has become home: she has Priya, pottery, Daniel about to be a short drive away, her mother stable, and a bowl sold, contrasting with the lonely, displaced person she was in March.
Mara made peace with Priyanka, concluding (2026-09-30) that the charge nurse / manager she had been wary of turned out to be one of the good ones once she stopped deciding she wasn't.

entities.name: Priyanka
entities.description: charge nurse / manager at the General; distinct from Mara's friend Priya

memories.content: Mara reflected (2026-09-30) that she has loosened from the person who gripped the clay too hard, and that this time she chose the hard ICU work on purpose rather than just surviving into it, though she is still tired and still wary of trusting good things.

On the eve of the changes (2026-09-30) Mara's anchors were Priya, pottery, Daniel soon nearby, her mother's stability, and a possible December visit from her mother, a sharp contrast to the lonely 2am of March.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's close friend; distinct from manager Priyanka
